svg.title: The 24 supported Milesight sensors
svg.desc: Cartoon sensor characters in six families. Air and climate: EM300-TH, AM300, TS201, TS301, TS302. Power and energy: WS523, CT101, CT103, CT301. Water and leaks: EM300-SLD, EM300-ZLD, EM300-MLD, EM300-DI, EM400-UDL, EM500-SWL, EM500-PP. People and spaces: VS121, VS133, VS125, EM300-MCS. Outdoor and ground: WTS506, EM500-SMTC, EM320-TILT. Control: UC300.
svg.text: Watts, amps, volts, kWh and cost

g.text: Unknown devices still appear, with every numeric field.
